ValidationRule.description: 當Transportation = Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family 親友接送(需提供司機身分證件) ，【Car Model (HYLG Only)】【Driver Info】【Driver's Birthday (HYLG Only)】【Driver's ID (HYLG Only)】【Driver's address (HYLG Only)】【Driver's Phone】為必填
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "Private Terminal Service", ISPICKVAL(Transportation__c, "Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family (driver’s ID required)"), ISPICKVAL( Private_Terminal_Type__c , "HYLG"), OR( ISBLANK(Car_Model_HYLG_Only__c), ISBLANK(Driver_Info__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_Birthday_HYLG_Only__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_ID_HYLG_Only__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_address_HYLG_Only__c), ISBLANK(Driver_s_Phone__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When the Transportation = Pick-up/drop-off by friend or family (Driver’s ID required),【Car Model】【Driver Info】【Driver's Birthday 】【Driver's ID】【Driver's address】【Driver's Phone】can't be empty.
